_comment: Pipeline: Shape development loop — generate test instances, then validate with hand-picked shapes.
_how_to_use: Fill in REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar run pipeline-shape-dev.json
name: Shape development loop
description: Generate synthetic instance data from an Excel template, then validate against SHACL shapes.

steps.name: Generate conforming instance data
steps._note: Generates a small RDF/XML file from the conform template. This file should PASS the shapes.
steps._note_templateXlsx: Excel template for a conforming instance. See gen-instances docs for the required format.

steps.name: Generate non-conforming instance data
steps._note: Generates a small RDF/XML file from the non-conform template. This file should FAIL the shapes.

steps.name: Validate fixtures against shapes
steps._note: Validates all .xml files in fixtures/ against the SHACL shapes. Conform should pass (0 violations); non-conform should fail (>0 violations). Check the Excel reports to verify both are working as expected.
steps._note_shaclConstraintFiles: The SHACL .ttl file(s) you are developing. Multiple files are unioned.
